hypothesis: Long 1-byte str.isspace() calls repeatedly enter generic Unicode whitespace checks; a single-pass 1-byte whitespace bitset should reduce parser/text workload runtime while preserving full Unicode semantics.
notes: 2026-04-25T14:53:22+00:00 Rejected: non-ASCII one-byte bitset improves synthetic Latin-1 isspace by about 1.6x, but ASCII/BMP and realistic stdlib-shaped workloads are flat; no total-runtime evidence for stacked promotion.
